# Disco NSVF Models
## Overview
Disco NSVF models represent 3D scenes using a disentangled radiance field, registered as `disco_nsvf` and `multi_disco_nsvf` [S1, unofficial]. The `disco_nsvf` variant uses `compressed_light_dim=64` and `nerf3_architecture`, while `multi_disco_nsvf` employs `multi_sparsevoxel_encoder` with `inputs_to_density="pos:10, context:0:256"` and `inputs_to_texture="feat:0:256, pos:10, normal:4, ray:4, context:0:256"` [S1, unofficial]. They differ from their sibling [SDF NSVF Models](11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md) by utilizing a disentangled radiance field representation rather than a unified SDF-based approach [G].

### [SDF NSVF Models](11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md)
SDF NSVF models are neural volume rendering models that use the `sdf_radiance_field` mechanism to predict both the signed distance to the surface and the view-dependent radiance [11064-sdf-nsvf-models.md]. They differ from their sibling [Disco NSVF Models](11063-disco-nsvf-models.md) by utilizing a unified SDF-based representation rather than a disentangled radiance field [G]. Choose this variant when explicit surface geometry extraction is required [G].

## Background
The Disco NSVF models are part of the NSVF framework developed by Facebook Research [S1, unofficial]. The source code is licensed under the MIT license [S1, unofficial].
